text:
ashley (AE): Morning team — Stargate kickoff at 11. They want a 2-week pilot to validate invoice/payment reconciliation prompts. Need golden set, success metrics, timeline, and call out security/pricing blockers ASAP.

miguel (Solutions Eng): Quick Q — are they ok with hosted sandbox or do they require private/Dedicated from day 1? Could change eval throughput/costs.

olga (Stargate PM): Hosted sandbox is fine for evaluation, but security questionnaire flagged HSM + KMS controls as a hard requirement for production. Also concerned about PII in prompts.

sam (Presales): OK — for POC scope let's plan hosted for functional eval + a private snapshot for the security team to review. For success criteria I propose:
- golden set: 150 labeled examples (mix of ideal/edge/failure cases)
- scoring: combined semantic + exact-match metric, threshold >= 0.82
- regression gate: any new model/version failing more than 3% relative drop triggers rollback
- latency SLO: median < 250ms for single-turn prompts
- cost cap: pilot budget $2k/week (approx token cap + reserve)

sam (Presales): Example scoring snippet (simple weighted combo):
```
# pseudo
semantic = embed_sim(query, golden) # cosine in [0,1]
exact = exact_match_score(pred, golden_label) # 0 or 1 or fuzzy
score = 0.7 * semantic + 0.3 * exact
pass = score >= 0.82
```

ashley (AE): Nice. Can we split golden set by intent buckets: reconciliation, dispute, partial refund, ambiguous descriptions? Stargate uses a lot of noisy OCR text. Need coverage for OCR errors.

miguel (Solutions Eng): Yep — recommend 40 reconciliation, 40 dispute, 30 refunds, 20 ambiguous, 20 OCR-noise. Also add 10 adversarial negatives. We'll tag each example with prompt template + allowed canonicalization.

olga (Stargate PM): Timeline check: we can assemble the golden examples in 3 days if you provide the template. Security questionnaire turnaround is likely 5–7 business days. Is that ok?

sam (Presales): That works. Action items: I will upload prompt templates and scoring harness by EOD. Miguel — can you provision hosted sandbox + token-limited API keys for Stargate? Devops — can we allow a one-off ephemeral workspace for their security team to test artifacts?

devops (oncall): I can spin up an isolated sandbox in the staging org. It will be behind IP allowlist and short-lived creds. ETA 24 hours. Note: if they request VPC peering or dedicated GPUs that's a 2–3 week infra queue.

security-bot: Security checklist reminder — POC plan must include: data retention policy, encryption-at-rest, KMS integration notes, redaction plan for PII, and SOC2 attestation docs. Upload to the shared drive so InfoSec can triage.

ashley (AE): Pricing question from customer: if they exceed pilot budget, what is the overage policy? We should give them clear per-token overage and also a pathway to Dedicated pricing.

sam (Presales): Suggest we offer: 10% grace, then prorated per-token at hosted rate. If usage regularly exceeds pilot cap, propose Dedicated quote with predictable throughput + commit discount. I'll draft language.

miguel (Solutions Eng): On evaluation gating — let's also include automatic regression tests driven by a holdout set (30 examples) that never touch training/hyperparams. If a new model fails holdout by >2% absolute we block rollout.

olga (Stargate PM): Sounds good. One more prod blocker: compliance team needs clarity on model provenance (which base model + quantization level). Can you include model metadata in every eval artifact?

sam (Presales): Yes — harness will capture: model id, quantization, tokenization settings, commit sha of serving runtime, and exact prompt templates.

ashley (AE): Wrap-up / next steps:
- Sam: upload harness + prompts (EOD)
- Miguel: sandbox provisioning (24h)
- Olga: produce golden dataset CSV (3 days)
- Devops: ephemeral workspace created (24h)
- Security: wait for Stargate questionnaire return (5-7bd)
If any of these slip, call it out and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:

olga (Stargate PM): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Will ping once questionnaire is back.

sam (Presales): I'll add the scoring thresholds + regression gating to the harness README and include a sample CSV format (cols: id, bucket, prompt, canonical_label, notes).
